summary: Proposal Phase 2, Task 2a — additive signatories foundation. Adds public.engagement_letter_signatories (one row per required signer of an engagement letter, carrying per-signatory signature evidence: signer_name, signer_email NOT NULL, signature_token uuid, signed_at, signature_ip, signature_user_agent, required boolean default true, sign_order, FK engagement_letter_id ON DELETE CASCADE, nullable person_id/contact_id/onboarding_application_id). RLS mirrors public.engagement_letters exactly (org-scoped SELECT via user_has_organization_access; manager-gated INSERT/UPDATE via user_has_role_at_least(...,'manager')); the live engagement_letters has NO token/public read policy (its public sign path is SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, not RLS) so none is mirrored. Adds public.protect_signatory_signature() BEFORE UPDATE trigger mirroring protect_engagement_letter_signatures: once signed_at is set, signed_at/signer_name/signer_email/signature_ip/signature_user_agent become immutable. Adds engagement_letters.signing_rule text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' with guarded CHECK signing_rule IN ('all','any'). ADDITIVE only: no signing RPC, gate, or UI changed; the table is neither populated nor read yet (Task 2d/2e wire it in). App-side, a forward-looking PROPOSAL_STATUSES constant adds 'partially_signed' in src/lib/db-constants/check-constraints.ts WITHOUT touching the registry-bound QUOTE_STATUSES — the live quotes_status_check does not yet allow 'partially_signed' (its DB CHECK update is Phase 2 T2d).

problem.context: Phase 2 needs an all-must-sign (default) / any-one-may-sign engagement-letter flow. Task 2a lays the additive foundation: a per-signatory model, a signing_rule on the letter, and the app vocabulary token — reusing the existing engagement-letters machinery (RLS shape + signature-immutability pattern), not a parallel system. Nothing behaves differently until 2d/2e populate and read it.
problem.scope: Additive only — one new table (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) + indexes, RLS enable + three policies (drop-then-create, idempotent), one new SECURITY DEFINER trigger function + BEFORE UPDATE trigger, one ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + one guarded CHECK. No existing object is altered or dropped; no signing RPC/gate/UI touched.
